result.instructions: Tools for Sellize, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many orders did my store take this week, and what did they contain?"; "Which products are out of stock right now?"; "Create a 15% coupon called SPRING15 that expires on 31 March.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sellize data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sellize_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sellize_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sellize_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sellize_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sellize_get_store
tools.title: Get the store
tools.description: Get the store's id, name, address, currency and the scopes this key holds. Good first call to check the connection. Sellize API: GET /v1/store.

tools.name: sellize_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the store's products, newest first, with prices, status and stock counts (stock is a number only for automatic products). Sellize API: GET /v1/products.

tools.name: sellize_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with its price, status, delivery type and stock. Sellize API: GET /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: sellize_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the store's orders, newest first, filtered by status or creation time. Delivered items are never included. Sellize API: GET /v1/orders.

created_after.description: Only orders created after this time, ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: sellize_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order with its items, the buyer's store credit used, and its kind (order, topup or giftcard). A gift card code is never included. Sellize API: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

tools.name: sellize_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the store's customers, or find one by email. Sellize API: GET /v1/customers.

email.description: Find the customer with this email address.

tools.name: sellize_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List the store's coupons, newest first. Sellize API: GET /v1/coupons.

tools.name: sellize_check_license
tools.title: Check a licence key
tools.description: Check whether a licence key from the store's stock was sold. The answer gives valid and status (sold, refunded, disputed, replaced, unsold or unknown). Sellize API: POST /v1/licenses/check.

tools.name: sellize_validate_license
tools.title: Validate a licence key on an installation
tools.description: Check whether a sold licence key is active on one installation. Answers valid true only for a sold key active on that instance. Sellize API: POST /v1/licenses/validate.

instance.description: The installation name the key was activated on.

annotations.title: Validate a licence key on an installation

tools.name: sellize_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a product in the store. It starts as a draft unless status is sent. An active product is visible to buyers at once. Sellize API: POST /v1/products.

delivery_type.description: How the buyer receives it: automatic takes keys from stock.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example EUR or USD.

status.description: active, draft, out_of_stock or archived (default draft).

tools.name: sellize_update_product
tools.title: Update a product
tools.description: Change the fields you send on one product, for example price or status. Fields you leave out stay as they are. A change is visible to buyers at once. Sellize API: PATCH /v1/products/{id}.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example EUR or USD.

tools.name: sellize_add_stock
tools.title: Add stock to a product
tools.description: Add keys, accounts or codes to an automatic product's stock, up to 1000 at a time. Items already in its stock are skipped. Added items can be sold to buyers. Sellize API: POST /v1/products/{id}/stock.

items.description: The stock items to add, one string each.

tools.name: sellize_create_coupon
tools.title: Create a coupon
tools.description: Create a discount coupon. discount_type is percentage or fixed. Buyers can use it at once. Sellize API: POST /v1/coupons.

discount_value.description: The percentage (for example 10) or the fixed amount.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Sellize
prompts.description: What you can do with Sellize here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_orders_and_stock_each_week
prompts.title: Check orders and stock each week
prompts.description: List the newest orders, filtered by status or creation time. Then list products to see the stock counts of automatic products.

prompts.name: refill_a_licence_key_product_from_a_list
prompts.title: Refill a licence key product from a list
prompts.description: Add up to 1000 keys to an automatic product's stock in one call. Items already in the stock are skipped. Check a key first to see if it was sold.

prompts.name: create_a_discount_coupon_for_a_promotion
prompts.title: Create a discount coupon for a promotion
prompts.description: Create a percentage or fixed coupon. Buyers can use it at once, so check the list of coupons first.

prompts.name: look_up_a_buyer_and_a_licence_key
prompts.title: Look up a buyer and a licence key
prompts.description: Find a customer by email. List the newest orders, then check whether a licence key was sold, refunded or disputed.

prompts.name: draft_a_new_product_and_publish_it
prompts.title: Draft a new product and publish it
prompts.description: Create a product, which starts as a draft. Update its price or status when it is ready. An active product is visible to buyers at once.
